short: A code that unlocks a specific offer at checkout.
seoTitle: Coupon Code — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: A coupon code is a text code that applies a specific discount at checkout. Untracked blanket discounts teach you nothing.
definition: A coupon code is a text code that applies a specific discount at checkout. Because each code can be tracked, coupons are how offline and online campaigns are measured.
bodyHtml:
Why Coupon Code matters

Coupons are measurable discounting — they tell you which campaign, channel or partner actually produced sales. Untracked blanket discounts teach you nothing.

Coupon Code formula

Campaign contribution = Incremental sales × Contribution margin − Discount value given

Only sales that would not have happened otherwise count as incremental.

How Coupon Code works in practice

Use a distinct code per channel and campaign, set an expiry and a usage cap, and check whether redemptions were incremental. Codes leaking onto deal sites is a common and expensive failure.

faq.question: Should coupon codes expire?
faq.answer: Yes. An expiry creates urgency and stops old campaigns discounting sales you would have made anyway.

faq.question: How do I stop code abuse?
faq.answer: Usage caps, per-customer limits and unique codes for high-value offers.
